richiami.difetto: On affected vehicles the software repair for previous recall 25C79 may not have been delivered properly and the Powertrain Control Module software may deliver lower power output than intended.
richiami.rimedio: Update the Powertrain Control Module software and perform an additional verification process to ensure the configuration has been installed correctly.
richiami.titolo: 25C79 Kuga - Powertrain Control Module Software Update

richiami.difetto: The diesel particulate filter (DPF) may be cracked on 2.0 l EcoBlue Diesel and 1.5 l EcoBlue vehicles. This could cause the vehicles to fail the legally required roadworthiness test, as exhaust emissions of soot may be above the authorised limit. The product does not comply with the Regulation on the approval and market surveillance of motor vehicles and their trailers, and of systems, components and separate technical units intended for such vehicles.
richiami.modello: Focus / C-MAX / Transit Connect / Galaxy / S-MAX / Mondeo / Kuga
richiami.rimedio: Type of economic operator taking notified measure(s): Manufacturer · Category of measure(s): Recall of the product from end users · Date of entry into force: Unknown
richiami.titolo: The diesel particulate filter (DPF) may be cracked on 2.0 l EcoBlue Diesel and 1.5 l EcoBlue vehicles.

traduzione.difetto: Il filtro a particelle diesel (DPF) potrebbe essere fratturato sui veicoli con motore 2.0 l EcoBlue Diesel e 1.5 l EcoBlue. Ciò potrebbe causare il fallimento del test di idoneità stradale obbligatorio, poiché le emissioni di fumi nell'uscita potrebbero superare il limite autorizzato. Il prodotto non rispetta il Regolamento sull'approvazione e la sorveglianza del mercato dei veicoli a motore e dei loro rimorchi, nonché dei sistemi, componenti e unità tecniche separate destinati a tali veicoli.
traduzione.rimedio: Tipo di operatore economico che ha adottato misura(i) notificata(e): Produttore · Categoria della misura(i): Ritiro del prodotto dagli utenti finali · Data di entrata in vigore: Sconosciuta
traduzione.titolo: Il filtro a particelle diesel (DPF) potrebbe essere fratturato sui veicoli con motore 2.0 l EcoBlue Diesel e 1.5 l EcoBlue.

richiami.difetto: Due to insufficient bonding, the panoramic roof may detach and fall onto the road. There is a risk of accident and injuries. The product does not comply with the Regulation on the approval and market surveillance of motor vehicles and their trailers, and of systems, components and separate technical units intended for such vehicles.
richiami.rimedio: Type of economic operator taking notified measure(s): Manufacturer · Category of measure(s): Recall of the product from end users · Date of entry into force: 18/09/2026
richiami.titolo: Due to insufficient bonding, the panoramic roof may detach and fall onto the road.

traduzione.difetto: A causa di un'adesione insufficiente, il tetto panoramico potrebbe staccarsi e cadere sulla strada. Esiste il rischio di incidenti e lesioni. Il prodotto non risponde al Regolamento sulla approvazione e sul controllo del mercato dei veicoli a motore e dei loro rimorchi, nonché dei sistemi, componenti e unità tecniche separate destinati a tali veicoli.
traduzione.rimedio: Tipo di operatore economico che ha adottato la misura(o) notificata: Produttore · Categoria della misura(o): Ritiro del prodotto dagli utenti finali · Data di entrata in vigore: 18/09/2026
traduzione.titolo: A causa di un'adesione insufficiente, il tetto panoramico potrebbe staccarsi e cadere sulla strada.

richiami.difetto: The rear axle joints may not have been tightened to the required torque during assembly. If an affected joint comes loose completely, the driver may notice a misalignment of the steering wheel when driving straight. In severe cases, the joint may fail without warning, resulting in a rear wheel losing directional control. Although the brakes remain functional, this instability could increase the risk of accidents. The product does not comply with the Regulation on the approval and market surveillance of motor vehicles and their trailers, and of systems, components and separate technical units intended for such vehicles.
richiami.rimedio: Type of economic operator taking notified measure(s): Manufacturer · Category of measure(s): Recall of the product from end users · Date of entry into force: 17/04/2026
richiami.titolo: The rear axle joints may not have been tightened to the required torque during assembly.

traduzione.difetto: Le giunzioni dell'asse posteriore potrebbero non essere state serrate con il momento richiesto durante l'assemblaggio. Se una giunzione interessata si allentasse completamente, il conducente potrebbe notare una deviazione della ruota di sterzo quando guida dritto. In casi gravi, la giunzione potrebbe fallire senza avviso, causando la perdita di controllo della ruota posteriore. Anche se i freni rimangono funzionanti, questa instabilità potrebbe aumentare il rischio di incidenti. Il prodotto non risponde al Regolamento sulla approvazione e sorveglianza del mercato dei veicoli a motore e dei loro rimorchi, nonché dei sistemi, componenti e unità tecniche separate destinati a tali veicoli.
traduzione.rimedio: Tipo di operatore economico che ha adottato la misura(o) notificata: Produttore · Categoria della misura(o): Ritiro del prodotto dagli utenti finali · Data di entrata in vigore: 17/04/2026
traduzione.titolo: Le giunzioni dell'asse posteriore potrebbero non essere state serrate con il momento richiesto durante l'assemblaggio.

richiami.difetto: Ford constantly monitors production processes and vehicles in service. While monitoring vehicles in operation we have become aware of a number of Ranger automatic transmission vehicles where you may experience no reverse motion when the gear selector is placed in reverse due to a potential issue with the transmission main control valve body. The Malfunction Indicator Light (MIL) and Wrench light will illuminate when this malfunction occurs. The vehicle could roll forward despite the gear selector being in the reverse position depending on where parked. Unexpected vehicle motion can increase the risk of a crash.
richiami.rimedio: Replace the transmission main control valve body
richiami.titolo: 25S19 Ranger – Automatic Transmission no reverse

richiami.difetto: According to Ford’s records certain Mustang vehicles may not have the remedy for Compliance Recall 21C11 installed correctly but were recorded as having received the repair successfully. Because the correct software update may not have been installed on these vehicles the underlying condition may still exist therefore these vehicles may still have the incorrect software loaded for the Lane Keeping System (LKS). On affected vehicles not having the latest Lane Keeping System (LKS) software may lead to non-compliance with the current regulations relating to Hands-On-Off (HOO) chime requirements that became effective from April 1 2021. Dealers will update the Image Processing Module A (IPMA) and the Power Steering Control Module (PSCM) to the latest available software level free of charge.
richiami.rimedio: Dealers will update the Image Processing Module A (IPMA) and the Power Steering Control Module (PSCM) to the latest available software level free of charge.
richiami.titolo: 26C16 Mustang  - Lane Keeping  System Software Update

richiami.difetto: According to Ford’s records certain Transit vehicles may not have the remedy for Compliance Recall 21C32 installed correctly but were recorded as having received the repair successfully. Because the correct configuration update may not have been installed on these vehicles the underlying condition may still exist therefore these vehicles may still have the incorrect configuration loaded onto the Instrument Panel Cluster (IPC). On affected vehicles an incorrect Instrument Panel Cluster (IPC) configuration may have disabled the Advanced Emergency Braking System warning messages. Although the system remains functional the instrument cluster may not display the required warning message and no chime may sound which could result in the vehicle not complying with applicable regulations. Dealers will update the Instrument Panel Cluster (IPC) configuration to the latest available level.
richiami.rimedio: Dealers will update the Instrument Panel Cluster (IPC) configuration to the latest available level.

richiami.difetto: An internal short circuit may occur in the cells of the high-voltage battery which can lead to a fire. In addition, a loss of propulsion power may occur, increasing the risk of accidents and injuries. The product does not comply with the Regulation on the approval and market surveillance of motor vehicles and their trailers, and of systems, components and separate technical units intended for such vehicles.
richiami.rimedio: Type of economic operator taking notified measure(s): Manufacturer · Category of measure(s): Recall of the product from end users · Date of entry into force: Unknown
richiami.titolo: An internal short circuit may occur in the cells of the high-voltage battery which can lead to a fire.

traduzione.difetto: Può verificarsi un cortocircuito interno nelle celle della batteria ad alta tensione, che può portare a un incendio. Inoltre, può verificarsi una perdita di potenza propulsiva, aumentando il rischio di incidenti e lesioni. Il prodotto non risponde al Regolamento sulla approvazione e sorveglianza del mercato dei veicoli a motore e dei loro rimorchi, nonché dei sistemi, componenti e unità tecniche separate destinati a tali veicoli.

richiami.rimedio: Inspect both rear brake calipers and replace any parts if necessary.

richiami.difetto: The wrong software for the power steering control module (PSCM) may have been installed. The steering wheel can perform autonomous movements when the driver attempts to steer, as the electric power steering (EPAS) provides unintended steering assistance. Unintended steering assistance may lead to loss of control over the vehicle while driving and thus to an increased risk of accidents and injuries. The product does not comply with the Regulation on the approval and market surveillance of motor vehicles and their trailers, and of systems, components and separate technical units intended for such vehicles.
richiami.rimedio: Type of economic operator taking notified measure(s): Other · Category of measure(s): Recall of the product from end users · Date of entry into force: Unknown
richiami.titolo: The wrong software for the power steering control module (PSCM) may have been installed.

traduzione.difetto: Potrebbe essere stato installato il software errato per il modulo di controllo del sistema di sterzo elettrico (PSCM). La ruota di sterzo può compiere movimenti autonomi quando il conducente cerca di sterzare, poiché il sistema di sterzo elettrico (EPAS) fornisce un'assistenza di sterzo non intenzionale. L'assistenza di sterzo non intenzionale può portare alla perdita di controllo del veicolo durante la guida e quindi a un aumento del rischio di incidenti e lesioni. Il prodotto non risponde al Regolamento sulla omologazione e la sorveglianza del mercato dei veicoli a motore e dei loro rimorchi, nonché dei sistemi, componenti e unità tecniche separate destinati a tali veicoli.

traduzione.titolo: Potrebbe essere stato installato il software errato per il modulo di controllo del sistema di sterzo elettrico (PSCM).

richiami.difetto: Ford constantly monitors production processes and vehicles in operation. While monitoring vehicles in operation we have become aware of a number of Transit Chassis vehicles which may require a strengthening plate to be fitted to the vehicle’s chassis. The strengthening plate is precautionary and will provide additional strength and durability for the life of the vehicle.
richiami.rimedio: The Ford dealer will visually inspect the affected chassis section for any initial damage and will install a reinforcement plate to prevent any potential future deformation.
richiami.titolo: 24B36 Transit - Chassis Inspection

richiami.difetto: Due to a manufacturing defect, the internal battery separator can become damaged over time by repeated charging and discharging cycles of the cells. This can cause the high voltage battery cells to develop an internal short circuit. This creates a risk of the vehicle catching fire. Moreover, the short circuit can cause a loss of propulsion power, increasing the risk of accidents and injuries. The product does not comply with the Regulation on the approval and market surveillance of motor vehicles and their trailers, and of systems, components and separate technical units intended for such vehicles.
richiami.rimedio: Type of economic operator taking notified measure(s): Manufacturer · Category of measure(s): Recall of the product from end users · Date of entry into force: Unknown
richiami.titolo: Due to a manufacturing defect, the internal battery separator can become damaged over time by repeated charging and discharging cycles of the cells.

traduzione.difetto: A causa di un difetto di fabbricazione, il separatore interno della batteria può diventare danneggiato nel tempo a causa di cicli ripetuti di carica e scarica delle celle. Ciò può provocare la formazione di un cortocircuito interno nelle celle a alta tensione. Ciò crea un rischio che il veicolo prenda fuoco. Inoltre, il cortocircuito può causare una perdita di potenza propulsiva, aumentando il rischio di incidenti e lesioni. Il prodotto non risponde al Regolamento sulla omologazione e la sorveglianza del mercato dei veicoli a motore e dei loro rimorchi, nonché dei sistemi, componenti e unità tecniche separate destinati a tali veicoli.

richiami.difetto: On vehicles with special rear-wheel suspension shock absorbers, corrosion can occur between the external reservoir, the mounting flange and the silencer. This can cause deterioration in the welding seams of the external  reservoir, which can lead to a fluid leak near the rear wheels, noises, detachment of the external reservoir and/or unstable road performance. External reservoirs on the rear shock absorbers which detach from the vehicle can pose a risk of injury to other road users. The product does not comply with the Regulation on the approval and market surveillance of motor vehicles and their trailers, and of systems, components and separate technical units intended for such vehicles.
richiami.rimedio: Type of economic operator taking notified measure(s): Manufacturer · Category of measure(s): Recall of the product from end users · Date of entry into force: Unknown

traduzione.difetto: Sui veicoli dotati di ammortizzatori posteriori con sospensione speciale, può verificarsi la corrosione tra il serbatoio esterno, la flangia di montaggio e lo scarico. Ciò può provocare il deterioramento dei giunti saldati del serbatoio esterno, che può portare a una fuoriuscita di fluido vicino alle ruote posteriori, rumori, distacco del serbatoio esterno e/o prestazioni stradali instabili. I serbatoi esterni degli ammortizzatori posteriori che si staccano dal veicolo possono costituire un rischio di lesioni per gli utenti della strada. richiami.difetto: On affected vehicles there may be a clash between a wiring harness and the brake lines. This could lead to wear corrosion and a brake tube leak leading to reduced stopping performance.
richiami.rimedio: Check the brake line and wiring harness and rework where necessary.
richiami.titolo: 24S74 – Transit and Tourneo Custom PHEV – Wiring harness to brake line touch condition

richiami.difetto: On affected vehicles there may be a clash between a wiring harness and the brake lines. This could lead to wear corrosion and a brake tube leak leading to reduced stopping performance.

richiami.titolo: 24S74 – Transit and Tourneo Custom PHEV – Wiring harness to brake line touch condition

richiami.difetto: On affected vehicles the clutch pedal spring may touch the Electric Power Assisted Steering wiring harness which may lead to clutch spring heat up and fall out a short circuit and loss of steering power assistance.
richiami.rimedio: Inspect and adjust the position of the wiring and if necessary repair any wiring damage.
richiami.titolo: Focus Clutch Pedal spring potential touch condition EPAS power Supply wiring

richiami.difetto: Affected vehicles potentially have a leaking screw connection in the rear left brake circuit. There is potential for the brake system to lack hydraulic pressure resulting in longer brake pedal travel and reduced brake performance.
richiami.rimedio: Replace the affected part.
richiami.titolo: 24S69 - Tourneo Connect Transt Connect - Potential leaky screw connection in the brake circuit

richiami.difetto: A small number of Transit vehicles have been manufactured with an incorrect tow bar that does not meet the correct load specifications. It is important for the affected vehicles to be returned to a Ford Authorised Dealer. A detached trailer or a damaged tow bar could increase the risk of an accident.

richiami.difetto: The wrong brake line hose may have been installed on the right rear. The longer brake line could create a touch condition with the rear wheel which could in turn cause a brake fluid leak. In the event of a leak you may notice a soft brake pedal feel and a red warning light will illuminate in the cluster. The brake system has two separate diagonal brake line circuits and in the event of one brake line circuit failure the vehicle is able to stop with the functionality of the secondary brake circuit. If the brake lines on both sides were to fail it may lead to a loss of brake function.
richiami.rimedio: Inspect and replace with correct hose.

traduzione.rimedio: Tipo di operatore economico che ha adottato la misura(o) notificata: Produttore · Categoria della misura(o): Ritiro del prodotto dagli utenti finali · Data di entrata in vigore: Sconosciuta
traduzione.titolo: Il rivestimento della colonna A potrebbe non essere fissato correttamente.

richiami.difetto: The cooling airflow is insufficient, causing the oil channel to be blocked. This leads the connecting rod bearing to seize and the connecting rod to tear off. This can deteriorate the combustion engine, resulting in a rupture in the engine oil tank or engine block, creating an oil tank leak. This increases the risk of fire under the bonnet. The product does not comply with the Regulation on the approval and market surveillance of motor vehicles and their trailers, and of systems, components and separate technical units intended for such vehicles.
richiami.rimedio: Type of economic operator taking notified measure(s): Importer · Category of measure(s): Recall of the product from end users · Date of entry into force: Unknown
richiami.titolo: The cooling airflow is insufficient, causing the oil channel to be blocked.

traduzione.difetto: L'aria di raffreddamento è insufficiente, causando il blocco del canale di lubrificazione. Ciò porta alla bloccatura del cuscinetto del bielle e alla rottura del bielle. Ciò può deteriorare il motore a combustione, provocando una rottura del serbatoio di olio o del blocco motore, creando una perdita di olio. Ciò aumenta il rischio di incendio sotto il cofano. Il prodotto non rispetta il Regolamento sulla approvazione e la sorveglianza del mercato dei veicoli a motore e dei loro rimorchi, e dei sistemi, componenti e unità tecniche separate destinati a tali veicoli.
traduzione.rimedio: Tipo di operatore economico che ha adottato misura(i) notificata(e): Importatore · Categoria di misura(i): Ritiro del prodotto dagli utenti finali · Data di entrata in vigore: Sconosciuta
traduzione.titolo: L'aria di raffreddamento è insufficiente, causando il blocco del canale di lubrificazione.

richiami.difetto: A small number of vehicles on which the fuel injectors may crack and leak. In the event of an injector failing this may result in fuel accumulating on the top of the engine. The accumulation of fuel could become the catalyst for a fire due to the proximity to the exhaust system and lack of an escape route for the leaking fuel.
richiami.rimedio: The dealer will fit a specially developed drain tube which will safely drain any leaking fuel away from hot surfaces like the cylinder head or exhaust. Also the vehicle software will be updated which will allow any drop in fuel pressure to be detected. This software will reduce the power of the engine if a drop in fuel pressure is detected and a warning light will be illuminated in the instrument cluster.
richiami.titolo: 24S16 - Kuga - PCM Programming and Drain Tube Installation

richiami.difetto: A small number of Courier vehicles that could potentially develop a touch condition over time between the brake line union nut and the fuel tank. If the brake line union nut connection becomes loose due to a touch condition with the fuel tank the friction with the fuel tank may lead to a brake fluid leak or in some cases a fuel leak from the fuel tank. If a brake fluid leak occurs the driver may notice reduced brake performance followed by a red warning light in the cluster. If a fuel leak occurs there is the potential for fuel to come into contact with hot surfaces from the exhaust system along with a strong smell of fuel.
richiami.rimedio: The affected vehicles will be inspected and a protective spacer that was designed to prevent any potential chaffing will be installed.
richiami.titolo: Potential touch condition between brake line union nut and fuel tank

For vehicles affected by this concern and have received an incomplete software update the Advanced Driver Assistance System (ADAS) will not function as designed. Customers will be presented with a yellow warning light in the vehicles cluster. For vehicles where no update was received there are no warning messages informing the customer that the ADAS system may not work as expected.

richiami.difetto: The steering gear could potentially develop excessive movement. Over time a wear condition may manifest in an audible noise increased steering efforts and the steering wheel not returning to the centre position. In rare circumstances if the issue of noise increased steering efforts and the steering wheel not returning to the centre position are not addressed the excessive movement in the steering gear may lead to the pinion shaft becoming disconnected from the steering rack.
richiami.rimedio: Replace affected components.
richiami.titolo: 23S57 Kuga - Steering gear top plug potentially loose

richiami.difetto: Potential leakage of battery acid around the battery negative terminal could cause the battery monitoring sensor to fail. Over time growth of copper sulphate may accumulate. This, in turn, could provide a conductive layer underneath the Battery Monitoring Sensor, creating a low resistance to ground. The increased current flow, due to low resistance, could cause the surrounding material to heat up to a point where it ignites, resulting in a fire.

richiami.difetto: A number of vehicles fitted with a 1.0 1.5 or 1.6 Ecoboost engine and 6-speed manual transmission could suffer clutch pressure plate fracture. This results in clutch smell reduced vehicle speed and performance. In the unlikely event of clutch pressure plate fracture a noise (thud / bang) could be heard from the vicinity of the transmission in extreme cases resulting in clutch / transmission fragments being released and striking under hood components creating a risk of smoke and fire from the under hood area.
richiami.rimedio: To prevent the repeated heating /cooling events a new calibration has been developed for vehicles fitted with Engine Stop Start feature. The software with the additional feature sets the Instrument panel �Wrench light� and de-rates the engine performance if prolonged clutch slip is detected. The software feature includes a drive cycle strategy for latching the wrench light and engine performance de-rate if the customer should experience repeated clutch slip events. For vehicles that do not have Engine Stop Start feature an alternative clutch kit has been released.
richiami.titolo: VEHICLE COULD SUFFER CLUTCH PRESSURE PLATE FRACTURE

richiami.difetto: In the vehicles concerned, an area containing insulation material is placed above the diesel particle filter. The diesel particle filter system automatically performs regeneration cycles in order to remove soot deposits from the filter. In this case the diesel particle filter can become so hot that the insulation material can ignite. This is theoretically possible even when the vehicle is parked.Three cases have been reported where insulation material and chassis parts were damaged during diagnosis by Ford dealers.

richiami.rimedio: Ford Dealers will fit an extension block to both rear caliper handbrake actuation levers.
richiami.titolo: PARKING BRAKE CONCERN.

richiami.difetto: The gearbox may incorrectly shift into a lower gear during normal driving.
richiami.rimedio: Recall affected vehicles and reprogramme the transmission control unit.
richiami.titolo: AUTOMATIC GEARSHIFT CONCERN.

richiami.difetto: The service replacement engine may have been fitted with with the rear lifting eye still attached. Under certain operating conditions the eye may contact and damage adjacent brake pipes. This could cause a loss of braking efficiency.
richiami.rimedio: Check for the presence of the rear lifting eye and remove if fitted. Check brake pipes for damage and if required replace.
richiami.titolo: POSSIBLE DAMAGE TO BRAKE PIPES.

richiami.difetto: The engine compartment wiring loom may chafe on one of the engine cooling system thermostat housing securing bolts. In the worst case circumstances this could result in a short circuit and a fire risk.
richiami.rimedio: Recall affected vehicles to reposition and protect the wiring loom from chafing.
richiami.titolo: ENGINE COMPARTMENT WIRING LOOM

richiami.difetto: Under conditions of excessively rough use such as driving over kerbs etc the front suspension ball joint taper pin may become loose in the suspension upright. If this occurs the secondary retaining circlip may be ineffective in preventing the complete detachment of the suspension upright from the track control arm.
richiami.rimedio: Replace the existing circlip with an improved design part.
richiami.titolo: FRONT SUSPENSION BALL JOINT CIRCLIP

richiami.difetto: The tailboard latch may not keep the tailboard in the closed position. This could result in the load dropping onto the highway.
richiami.rimedio: Modify the tailboard latch.
richiami.titolo: TAILBOARD LATCH CONCERN

richiami.difetto: It is possible that the rough surface of the heater blower resistor's stainless steel connector blades can damage the copper surface of the wiring harness connector. This could result in arcing and overheating of the wiring connector.
richiami.rimedio: Install a revised heater blower resistor and a revised wire jumper harness.
richiami.titolo: OVERHEATING OF WIRING HARNESS CONNECTORS

richiami.difetto: The design of the parking brake ratchet teeth can allow a partial engagement resulting in damage to the tooth which can then slip to the next tooth. If ignored the wear will continue on the next tooth and the efficiency of the parking brake may become insufficient to hold the vehicle in place.
richiami.rimedio: Replace parking brake lever assembly with one that has a revised tooth profile.
richiami.titolo: PARKING BRAKE RATCHET CONCERN

richiami.difetto: The design of the parking brake ratchet teeth can allow a partial engagement resulting in damage to the tooth which can then slip to the next tooth. If ignored the wear will continue on the next tooth and the efficiency of the parking brake may become insufficient to hold the vehicle in place.
richiami.rimedio: Replace parking brake lever assembly with one that has a revised tooth profile.
richiami.titolo: PARKING BRAKE RATCHET CONCERN

richiami.difetto: Affected vehicles have brass terminal (instead of bronze) in the brake lamp switch jumper harness. This could lead to malfunction of the brake lamp switch.
richiami.rimedio: Brake lamp switch jumper harness to be replaced on all affected vehicles brake lamp switch to be inspected for heat damage and replaced if necessary.
richiami.titolo: BRAKE LAMP SWITCH JUMPER HARNESS CONCERN

richiami.difetto: Battery cable may be misrouted and/or a loose connection at the alternator B+ stud which could cause a risk of an electrical short.
richiami.rimedio: B+ stud torque to be checked. Battery cable routing to be checked and any damaged cables to be replaced.
richiami.titolo: BATTERY CABLE AND ALTERNATOR B+ STUD CONCERN.

richiami.difetto: It has been established that the seat belt stalks may fail due to abuse by passengers.
richiami.rimedio: Replace the seat belt stalks with a stronger design.
richiami.titolo: THAT THE SEAT BELT STALKS WILL NOT RESIST PASSENGER ABUSE.

richiami.difetto: One or both front stabiliser bar links may break. Under certain conditions vehicle handling may be affected if one or both of the front stabiliser bar links are broken.
richiami.rimedio: Both front stabiliser bar links will be replaced with new 10 - millimetre service stabiliser bar links.
richiami.titolo: FRONT STABILISER BAR LINKS.

richiami.difetto: The metal brake pipe linking the front brake circuit to the rear brake pressure regulation valve may chafe on floorpan which could over time lead to perforation brake fluid loss and consequential reduced brake efficiency.
richiami.rimedio: Recall affected vehicles inspect adjust clearance/renew brake pipe as appropriate.
richiami.titolo: BRAKE PIPE MAY CHAFE ON FLOORPAN

richiami.difetto: Excessive crankshaft end-float may allow the torque converter to contact the crankshaft position sensor. Damage to the crankshaft position sensor may lead to engine cut-out/stall.
richiami.rimedio: Recall affected vehicles for fitment of a revised crankshaft thrust bearing assembly and a new crankshaft position sensor.
richiami.titolo: ENGINE MAY CUT-OUT/STALL

richiami.difetto: Corrosion of the rear brake pressure limiting valve may allow brake fluid to leak from a joint.
richiami.rimedio: Recall affected vehicles and replace pressure limiting valve.
richiami.titolo: BRAKE FLUID MAY LEAK FROM PRESSURE LIMITING VALVE

richiami.difetto: Engine may lose power due to a malfunction in the power train control module software.
richiami.rimedio: Recall affected vehicles and re-programme the power train module.
richiami.titolo: ENGINE MAY LOSE POWER

richiami.difetto: Oil filler cap may become loose resulting in oil dripping onto the exhaust heat shield.
richiami.rimedio: Replace oil filler cap with a new redesigned version.
richiami.titolo: OIL FILLER CAP MAY BECOME LOOSE

richiami.difetto: Some vehicles have been built with door latches which may not be to specification. An internal plastic pawl within the assembly may seize which results in the latch failing to function as designed preventing the door being securely shut.
richiami.rimedio: Recall affected vehicles and fit quality assured replacement door latches.
richiami.titolo: DOOR LATCH CONCERN

richiami.rimedio: Phase 1 - Write to owners advising them to immediately stop using the cruise control system and offering them the option of dealers disabling the system should they so wish. Phase 2 - As soon as replacement cruise control cables become available  recall all affected vehicles for replacement of the cable.

richiami.rimedio: Affected vehicles are being recalled for checking and where necessary replacement of the brake master cylinder.

richiami.rimedio: Affected vehicles are being recalled for checking and where necessary replacement of the brake master cylinder.

richiami.difetto: Two conditions have been identified that may inhibit the throttle pedal from returning to its normal idle position. 1) The possibility that a loose or incorrectly located floor mat may interfere with the lower edge of the pedal assembly and 2) A potential foul condition between the engine compartment bulkhead insulation material and the throttle cable.
richiami.rimedio: Recall all affected vehicles to fit revised design floor mats and securing system. A revised design quality assured throttle pedal and associated hardware is also being fitted to provide increased clearance between the lower edge of the pedal and the carpet. This recall supersedes R1998/038.

richiami.difetto: The child seat upper base frame and inbuilt seat belt retractor assemblies may not meet the appropriate EC crash testing requirements.
richiami.rimedio: Integrated child seats supplied with Galaxys from Jan 96 to Apr 1997 are being recalled for replacement of the upper base frames with modified versions. In addition belt retractors are being replaced with modified units on integrated seats supplied with Galaxys built between 1st January 1996 and October 1996. Ford are also advising all other Galaxy owners who have purchased the subject seat.

richiami.rimedio: Recall the affected vehicles for the fitment of a new level charge relay. At the same time the engine compartment wiring loom will be inspected replaced if damaged or retaped with new level insulation tape if undamaged.
richiami.titolo: WIRING LOOM INSULATION ALSO SPLIT CHARGE RELAY CAPACITY

richiami.rimedio: Recall the affected vehicles for the fitment of a supplementary return spring between the brake pedal and the brake servo housing.

richiami.rimedio: Recall the affected vehicles for the fitment of new seals to the brake master cylinder. At the same time the brake/clutch hydraulic systems will be purged of the original fluid and new clutch hoses will be fitted. In addition vehicles built prior

richiami.rimedio: Recall the affected vehicles to have the tyre ply ratings checked and where necessary to have correctly rated tyres fitted.
richiami.titolo: TYRE PLY RATING MAY BE INCORRECT

richiami.difetto: 1) Due to a defect in the clutch master cylinder the clutch may not disengage. 2) Water ingress to brake servo. 3) The front brake hoses may be incorrectly routed and could in some circumstances contact the retaining bracket nut. 4) Possible contamination
richiami.rimedio: Recall the affected vehicles and:- 1) Check build date and replace clutch master cylinder where required. 2) Fit a water shield to the brake servo to protect the servo push rod. 3) Check the routing of the front brake hoses re-routing where required.

richiami.difetto: On vehicles where the rear axle mounting arrangement is by means of studs and bolts the axle assembly may become loose to the vehicle underbody.
richiami.rimedio: Recall the affected vehicles for the fitment of modified axle mounting blocks to the vehicle underbody and replacement of the subject studs and nuts by bolts.
richiami.titolo: INSECURITY OF REAR AXLE

richiami.difetto: It is possible that some Mondeo vehicles may have been fitted with a right hand front brake caliper where the casting is not to specification. In time this may result in fluid leakage with the loss of one brake circuit.
richiami.rimedio: Recall the affected vehicles for a check on the manufacturing date of the subject caliper. Caliper units falling within the affected range will be replaced.
richiami.titolo: POSSIBLE FAILURE OF OFFSIDE FRONT BRAKE CALIPER

richiami.titolo: FAILURE OF BRAKING SYSTEM VACUUM ASSISTANCE

richiami.difetto: The stop light switch on a small number of the subject vehicles may not operate as intended. Should this occur the stop lights may fail to illuminate when the footbrake is applied.
richiami.rimedio: Recall the affected vehicles for replacement of the stop light switch with a switch of the latest specification.
richiami.titolo: STOP LIGHT SWITCH MAY BE FAULTY

richiami.difetto: The stop light switch on a small number of the subject vehicles may not operate as intended. Should this occur the stop lights may fail to illuminate when the footbrake is applied.
richiami.rimedio: Recall the affected vehicles for replacement of the stop light switch with a switch of the latest specification.
richiami.titolo: STOP LIGHT SWITCH MAY BE FAULTY

richiami.difetto: It is possible that the two bolts securing the rear brake cylinder to the brake back plate may not have been fully tightened. If the bolts were to come loose the efficiency of that brake circuit could be impaired.
richiami.rimedio: Recall the affected vehicles to tighten the subject bolts to the correct specification.
richiami.titolo: POSSIBILITY OF REAR BRAKE CYLINDERS BEING INSECURE

richiami.difetto: The hydraulic hoses to the rear brake calipers may have been incorrectly routed. This could result in contact between the hose and the suspension system with consequent damage to the hose.
richiami.rimedio: Recall the affected vehicles to check and where necessary re-route the subject hoses. Any damaged hoses will be replaced.
richiami.titolo: CHAFING OF BRAKE HOSES

richiami.difetto: S maximum speed rated tyres have been fitted. As the vehicle maximum capability exceeds the maximum speed rating of the S rated tyre vehicle stability could be adversely affected on a vehicle travelling in excess of the speed rating.
richiami.rimedio: Recall the affected vehicles and replace the tyres with T maximum speed rated examples.
richiami.titolo: INCORRECTLY RATED TYRES

richiami.difetto: The nuts securing the road wheels may not have been tightened to the correct torque and could become loose.
richiami.rimedio: Recall the affected vehicles and tighten the wheel nuts to the correct torque. Any damage to wheels or studs caused as a result of undertorqueing will be addressed at the recall.
richiami.titolo: WHEEL NUTS INSUFFICIENTLY TORQUED

richiami.difetto: The nuts securing the road wheels may not have been tightened to the correct torque and could become loose.
richiami.rimedio: Recall the affected vehicles and tighten the wheel nuts to the correct torque. Any damage to wheels or studs caused as a result of undertorqueing will be addressed at the recall.
richiami.titolo: WHEEL NUTS INSUFFICIENTLY TORQUED

richiami.difetto: Due to misplacement of the cap ply tyres may lose pressure through a crack in the butyl inner liner. This may have an adverse affect on vehicle control.
richiami.rimedio: Recall the affected vehicles and check/replace the tyres as necessary with a different construction tyre.
richiami.titolo: LOSS OF TYRE PRESSURE

richiami.difetto: Due to misplacement of the cap ply tyres may lose pressure through a crack in the butyl inner liner. This may have an adverse affect on vehicle control.

richiami.difetto: As a result of tightness in the throttle spindle and/or fouling of the speed control cable on the inlet manifold the throttle may not return to the idle position when the accelerator pedal is released.
richiami.rimedio: Recall the affected vehicles and replace the speed control cable with the latest level type and if necessary also replace the throttle body assembly with the latest level type.
richiami.titolo: THROTTLE MAY NOT RETURN TO IDLE POSITION

richiami.difetto: A possibility exists that excessive torque generated when turning on the headlamp switch may induce an internal open circuit and cause the headlamps to go out.
richiami.rimedio: Recall the affected vehicles for replacement of the headlamp switch with a revised component.

richiami.rimedio: Recall the affected vehicles for replacement of the exhaust downpipe with the current production component.

richiami.rimedio: Recall the affected vehicles for reinforcement of both strut brackets and replacement of any brackets found to be bent.
richiami.titolo: TAILGATE STRUT BRACKETS MAY BEND.

richiami.difetto: A small number of subject vehicles may have been equipped with front brake discs of insufficient metal thickness. This could adversely affect braking performance.
richiami.rimedio: Recall the affected vehicles for examination of the front brake discs. Where any disc does not meet the manufacturers dimensional specification both front discs will be renewed.
richiami.titolo: FRONT BRAKE DISCS OF INSUFFICIENT THICKNESS

richiami.difetto: The welds securing the front towing eye to its mounting bracket are not to specification and can result in detachment of the eye when the vehicle is under tow.
richiami.rimedio: Recall the affected vehicles for inspection of the welds which secure the front towing eye. Where these are not to specification the welds will be reworked as per the manufacturers instructions.
richiami.titolo: INSECURITY OF FRONT TOWING EYE

richiami.difetto: The battery cable terminal may touch the starter motor solenoid body at the point of attachment to the starter motor. This could result in a short circuit.
richiami.rimedio: Recall the affected vehicles and check the angle of attachment to the starter motor terminal. Where this is close to or touching the starter motor solenoid body it will be repositioned to ensure that adequate clearance is maintained.
